observations.finding: captureWork8Recovery rejects requireComplete other than explicit false. Current coordination composes primary/background/shared queue/local admission/SQLite/native/domain capture fences; does not establish complete runtime topology.

capture inventory requires explicit inspection scope. restoreWork8RedisInspection pins distinct Redis identity, restores TTL-aware rows, preserves persistent capture-owner and paused state; returns bootAllowed false and no execution authority.

Fixed inventory has nine system-vault databases plus brain, missions, execution and shadow (13 SQLite stores), authority and request-owner JSON, optional watchdog JSON and optional lifecycle markers. Manifest explicitly records incomplete global producer/watchdog/continuation coverage and bootAllowed=false, completeLiveState=false.
Disposable copies reopened through intelligence/reasoning/financial/commerce adapters prove scoped data compatibility only; no complete application boot, replay or custody.

topologyPrerequisites: Identify every admitted process and transport in the actual declared runtime topology, including still-active prior binaries and worker/primary roles.
Establish exclusion and drain for non-Brain Redis producers, executive watchdog and Amazon continuation alongside existing coordinated fences.
Bind source shutdown/quarantine and fresh target identity to the restore operation; do not infer source exclusion from inspection restore caller preconditions.
inventoryPrerequisites: Map all persistent runtime state to explicit capture and target paths, including data outside the fixed SQLite/JSON map.
Account for writable visual-memory state: it is not an entry in the inspected fixed recovery store map; establish whether/how its state belongs in the required runtime snapshot.
Preserve database lifecycle markers, authority/request ownership records, authenticated Redis sessions and expiry, pending work, finance records and mission records.
remainingExecutableAssertions: Complete consistent capture across all declared stores and writers.
Validated atomic materialization of databases, JSON and lifecycle markers into a distinct fresh target, with failure cleanup and no partial admission.
Original authenticated sessions restored with correct TTL and source/target Redis pinning.
Actual complete application startup/readiness after authorized restoration with NOT_BORN, LOCKED and all live-effect fences preserved.
Finance and mission canonical invariants and once-only pending continuation, including verification across an additional restart.
Reject stale, partial, mismatched, aliased or incomplete capture/restore inputs.

separateExternalBoundary.required: Existing qualifying independently authenticated off-host custody, protected retention and runtime credentials denied alteration/deletion, plus actual protected readback/restoration evidence.
separateExternalBoundary.notASubstitute: Protected custody configuration does not replace full restoration engineering; incomplete engineering must not be reported as solely externally blocked.

preservedSubclaims: Owner-directed preservation of reviewed cold-process replay and cooperating multi-process authority-lock results; these do not establish every writer or full restore.
Existing scoped Redis inspection replacement and domain-adapter rehydration remain scoped; do not promote them to operational recovery.
decision: No restore-plan-only implementation added because it cannot close the package and would expand the current ten-path batch. Full recovery remains authorised unfinished engineering, requiring the listed coordinated work and examination.
